interface.shortDescription: Direct Brand Packs or provisional projects.
interface.longDescription: Brand Runtime validates external Brand Packs for official identity or directs explicitly provisional brand-pending projects without claiming brand compliance. It discovers the deliverable, creates project-specific design direction, guides stack selection, records project-local learning, and promotes only explicit lasting rules from a validated brand.
